source_findings: Scan reuse does not imply reusable hash build: hash_join_ref picks left on ties and smaller side per block. The existing70000-row two-pattern fixture need not ever build RHS; it cannot by itself prove a hash-hoist benefit.

Only an already-chosen RHS-build hash branch over the same retained immutable RHS and same ordered key projection is a plausible narrow reuse boundary. Do not pin RHS as build side or hoist planner/bind decisions.

Probe columns/out_vars may change with per-block earlier joins even if build key unchanged. Recompute these; preserve posting index order, original parallel partition representation, sortedness and budget polling.

Existing4MiB scan accounting excludes JoinTable buckets/control bytes and spilled Key/Posting vectors. Adding tables without honest charged capacity would reopen resolved retention issue. No safe accounting implementation investigated in this paused read-only phase.
witness_direction: Need public capped query proving at least two RHS-build calls on the same relation/layout, independently of scan reuse, plus exact bag and physical build count. Existing scan-only counter and symmetric70k fixtures are insufficient. A filtered RHS with high prepared estimate but smaller actual scan, or preceding fanout, is a candidate shape; actual planner/path and reasonable resource cost remain unverified. No discriminator has yet been executed.
proposed_control: If a witness is established later, discard cached hash preparation per block: assert repeated RHS table constructions return while full result bag remains identical. No wall-clock unit assertion.
semantic_traps: RHS ownership/generation changes on sort replacement; table row indices cannot outlive/refer to the old rows.
Shared key order/column identity differs from probe layout; changing build side changes output layout and enumeration.
Unbound/duplicate rows and posting multiplicity must retain current semantics; no global unordered output assumption.
Parallel threshold selects one table versus64 partitions; probe partition hash must match.
Cache disabled under armed budgets; preserve all old cancellation checks and existing ZK caller guard.
